I don’t really care about much anymore, even stuff I used to be proud of, like my performance reports or qualifying on new systems. Then there are these stretches—like the one that lasted about a month a few months back—where I flip. My mood jumps between feeling on top of the world and getting irritated over nothing. I hardly sleep, maybe a couple of hours, and don’t even feel tired. I can’t sit still; I’m pacing in the barracks or fiddling with things nonstop. My thoughts race, I’m talking constantly in briefings and in the mess, almost like I can’t tolerate silence. I get more hyper and impulsive during those times, but that only happens in those “up” periods, not all the time and not since childhood.

    C. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)

My thoughts felt like they were racing ahead of me, and I barely slept—maybe three hours a night—but didn’t feel tired.
